entry_points.summary: Shared helpers: GlobalLockContext, acquire/release_global_lock, get_config_batch, project_followups_dir (via plan-path.sh followups_dir at call time), _notion_push_entry_bg, log_sink_event, log_metrics_event, iso_now, git_head; OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY set at import

Writer primitive; validates inputs, deduplicates (name+cmd hash), computes file/dir blob hashes, acquires global lock via GlobalLockContext, appends entry_created, rebuilds view; exit codes 0/2/3/4/5/6
Atomic open->running claim; per-entry lock FIRST then global; re-checks status from view; staleness check; appends status_changed; emits claim ticket JSON with holder+pid for identity verification

Generic status transition primitive; verifies per-entry lock via claim ticket or re-acquires; validates state machine; enforces completion_mode mutex for verify->done; appends status_changed; rebuilds view; triggers Notion sync bg
Replays index.jsonl into index.view.json via reducer; exits 4 if global lock not held (JSON content OR OS flock check); passes --repair/--full flags to reducer

Incremental+full replay reducer; writes atomic tmpfile+rename view with _checkpoint {event_count, journal_byte_length, tail_sha256, tail_len}; handles notion_sync_pending/synced/cleared; exits 3 on corruption without touching view; --repair strips tail; --full forces cold replay

Per-entry flock + heartbeat via background daemon; subcommands: acquire, heartbeat, release, check-stale, read-holder; daemon identity verified via zero_lock_under_hblock marker before SIGTERM; stale threshold 7200s

CLI view-lookup helper; --mode=find searches project+global by entry-id (returns {found, entry, sink}); --mode=load dumps all entries from one sink (stamps entry[sink] on entries missing field); never errors on missing/invalid view

Log compaction: evicts terminal entries to index.archive.jsonl; atomically rewrites index.jsonl with live lines; deletes index.view.json to invalidate T010 checkpoint; runs --full rebuild; logs followup_log_compacted; must be called under global lock

11-point audit evidence validator; checks both legacy (z-harness/<plan>/archive/) and canonical (z-harness/plans/<plan>/archive/) trust-root layouts; rejects empty paths and path-traversal in verified_by_run

Auto-close ceiling check: kill-switch, auto_close_eligible, completion_mode=null, test_exit=0, then diff noop (diff_stat==0 AND no touched paths) OR all-allowlist (denylist wins); accepts numstat and unified diff formats

One-way best-effort Notion push; token from Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN env or secrets.toml; 3-attempt exponential backoff (1s/4s/16s) with Retry-After header support; verifies z_harness_entry_id before update; exit 0/4/5/6/7

Sweeps notion_sync_pending entries in both sinks; project sink root resolved via project_followups_dir at call time; fetches config once with get_config_batch; uses --check-existing to dedup before create; appends notion_synced+notion_sync_cleared on success

Tolerant parser for **FOLLOWUPS:** fenced JSON blocks in reviewer returns; validates per-entry: priority, name, recommended_command (COMMAND_RE + control chars + length), cited_paths (cap 16); logs and skips invalid entries; never aborts

Interactive consumer (10 phases + cleanup): nest guard, heuristic lock probe (NOT mutual-exclusion), running-entry check, enumerate+sort claimable (depth<1 only), AskUserQuestion select, worktree check, staleness prompt, claim+heartbeat, Skill execute with depth=1, status writeback via claim ticket, auto-close attempt, kill-heartbeat-BEFORE-lock-release, push-notify
Read-only merged view from project+global sinks; filters: --status=, --sink=, --priority=; --json; table includes Notion sync pending column; never rebuilds view
Read-only diagnostic: counts per status, Notion sync pending count, per-entry + global lock state (flock-probed, not just JSON), oldest open entry age, last sync failure from index.jsonl
verify->done transition; --via=human prompts AskUserQuestion; --via=audit runs 11-point evidence validator; completion_mode mutex enforced
Any-state -> dismissed transition; requires --reason; terminal; done->dismissed stamps dismissed_after_done=true
For blocked (staleness) entries only: re-stamps capture_head + file_blob_hashes, transitions back to open; cannot refresh open entries directly
JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for entry objects; enforces blob_hashes_mutex (exactly one of file_blob_hashes/dir_blob_hashes non-null); additionalProperties: true for forward-compat
JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for audit evidence blobs; review_verdict const PASS, test_exit_code const 0, verify_head must descend from capture_head

shared_module.note: Single home for all lock primitives and Notion push; eliminates per-caller reimplementation. Sets OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES at module import to prevent macOS fork-safety abort when Python is invoked from bash.

project_sink_root_resolution.mechanism: calls plan-path.sh followups_dir at invocation time with cwd=proj_root
project_sink_root_resolution.call_time_semantics: resolved on every call, not frozen at import or process start
project_sink_root_resolution.fallback: proj_root/z-harness/followups when plan-path.sh absent or fails

macos_fork_safety.reason: bash initialises CoreFoundation before Python; any subsequent fork+exec (subprocess with cwd= or env=) in the child can abort on macOS without this guard
macos_fork_safety.inherited_by: all child processes spawned by any importer of followup_common

files.<lock>.flock: OS LOCK_EX sentinel (authoritative for mutual exclusion)
files.<lock>.hb.lock: serializer sentinel -- ALL JSON reads/writes under this flock

per_entry_lock.mechanism: background daemon holds fcntl.LOCK_EX for lock lifetime; heartbeat every 30s under .hb.lock
per_entry_lock.held_during: status transitions, evidence writes, command execution
per_entry_lock.daemon_identity_marker: zero_lock_under_hblock -- checked in process cmdline before SIGTERM
per_entry_lock.wrong_schema_sentinel: _WRONG_SCHEMA -- parseable JSON but not valid holder; treated as stale (not free)
per_entry_lock.corrupt_sentinel: _CORRUPT -- non-empty unparseable JSON; requires manual cleanup (exit 3)

lock_ordering: MANDATORY AND UNCHANGED: per-entry FIRST then global. Any code path needing both locks must follow this order. Inversion causes deadlock.

modes.find: --mode=find --id=<entry-id> -- searches project then global; returns {found, entry, sink}
modes.load: --mode=load --sink=project|global -- dumps all entries; stamps entry[sink] on missing field

view_lookup_helper.error_handling: returns [] or {found: false} on missing/invalid view; never raises

incremental_checkpoint.strategy: seek to journal_byte_length, verify tail_sha256 fingerprint, fold only suffix bytes
incremental_checkpoint.fallback: full cold replay on journal truncation, tail mismatch, or absent checkpoint
incremental_checkpoint.invalidated_by: any in-place journal rewrite (compaction must delete index.view.json before rebuilding)

compaction.evicts: terminal entries (done, dismissed) from index.jsonl to index.archive.jsonl
compaction.lock_requirement: caller must hold global cross-tool lock; script does NOT acquire lock itself

corruption_detection.repair_mode: --repair strips broken tail-only truncation; interior corruption is a hard error

notion_sync_state.semantics: last-writer-wins; reconciler _find_pending_entry_ids replays journal for same result

notion_token.warning: do not use set -x when Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN is set -- token leaks to logs

fields.name: string -- short human title
fields.status: enum -- open | running | verify | done | failed | blocked | dismissed
fields.sink: enum -- project | global  (Notion is a mirror, never a sink enum value)
fields.created_by_run: string -- RUN id of creating command
fields.capture_head: string -- git SHA at create time
fields.recommended_command: string -- must match /z-[a-z][a-z-]*[a-z](\s.*)? pattern; max 2048 chars
fields.file_blob_hashes: map<path, sha256:hex> -- mutex with dir_blob_hashes; sha256 of file bytes
fields.dir_blob_hashes: map<ancestor-dir, sha256:hex> -- sha256 of git ls-tree -r output; mutex with file_blob_hashes
fields.depth: int -- 0 | 1; from Z_HARNESS_FOLLOWUP_CALLER_DEPTH at create time
fields.auto_close_eligible: bool -- producer declares; consumer ceiling still applies
fields.attempt_count: int -- incremented on each failed attempt
fields.status_history: array of {ts, from, to, by} objects
fields.notion_sync_pending: bool | absent -- materialized by reducer from journal events
fields.content_hash: string -- sha256(name + NUL + recommended_command); dedup key
fields.dismissed_after_done: bool | absent -- set by reducer on done->dismissed transition

entry_schema.blob_hash_format: sha256:<64-hex-chars> -- raw file bytes hashed, NOT git hash-object
entry_schema.dir_blob_hashes_rule: sha256 of git ls-tree -r <capture_head> <ancestor>/ output; ancestor must be depth >= 2 from repo root

transitions.preconditions: per-entry lock acquired; depth<1; not stale (or --allow-stale)
staleness drift or external dep missing
dead PID OR heartbeat stale >2h; logs followup_lock_takeover
auto_close_eligible AND ceiling passes AND completion_mode==null; completion_mode=auto_closed_low_risk

state_machine.verify_done_mutex: completion_mode is one-way and mutually exclusive; at most one of {human_confirmed, audit_confirmed, auto_closed_low_risk} per entry

validation_checks: 3. entry_id matches the entry being confirmed
4. review_verdict_path and diff_artifact_path both exist on disk (non-empty string paths)
8. verified_by_run is a valid run id in some plan's archive (no path separators or ..) -- both legacy and canonical layouts
9. diff_artifact_path touches at least one cited_path
10. review_verdict_path content references entry_id OR recommended_command
11. audit_evidence.json must live under trusted run-archive path (both layouts)
audit_evidence.on_any_fail: logs followup_audit_evidence_rejected with rejected_check: <number>; stays at verify

auto_close_ceiling.kill_switch: followup.auto_close_low_risk_enabled -- fails CLOSED when config.py present but unreadable
auto_close_ceiling.eligibility: auto_close_eligible==true AND completion_mode is null AND command exited 0
auto_close_ceiling.pass_condition_A: diff_stat == 0 AND touched_paths is empty (true no-op; binary/rename/mode-only has touched_paths and must pass B)
auto_close_ceiling.pass_condition_B: ALL touched paths match allowlist AND NONE match denylist (denylist takes precedence)
auto_close_ceiling.diff_formats: numstat and unified diff both accepted

command_allowlist.shell_metacharacters: must be quoted (;, |, &, `, $(, >, <, newline outside quotes rejected)

depth_cap.depth_1_entries: inert; consumer Phase 1 filter excludes them (depth < 1)

staleness_check.hash_format: sha256: content hash of raw file bytes (NOT git hash-object)
staleness_check.hard_auto_dismiss: staleness_hard_dismiss_days > 0 AND now > created_at + N days; default 0 (disabled)
prompt_options: refresh (re-stamp; transitions to blocked, then user runs /z-followup-refresh)

z_followup_next_phases.phase_0_1: Heuristic global lock probe (5s timeout) -- NOT mutual-exclusion guarantee
z_followup_next_phases.phase_0_2: Running-entry check: refuse if any project sink entry has status=running
z_followup_next_phases.phase_1: Enumerate both sinks, merge into priority-sorted view, exclude depth=1
z_followup_next_phases.phase_2: AskUserQuestion select (TOP_N default 10, configurable via Z_HARNESS_FOLLOWUP_TOP_N); --non-interactive claims [1]
z_followup_next_phases.phase_3: Worktree check; --force-dirty to override; pre-run diff captured
z_followup_next_phases.phase_4: Staleness check vs file_blob_hashes/dir_blob_hashes + commit distance
z_followup_next_phases.phase_5: Claim: sink-claim.sh (per-entry FIRST then global); spawn heartbeat background subprocess with EXIT trap
z_followup_next_phases.phase_6: Execute: set Z_HARNESS_FOLLOWUP_CALLER_DEPTH=1, Skill invoke, unset immediately after
z_followup_next_phases.phase_7: Status writeback: verify on exit 0, failed on non-zero; claim ticket for identity verification
z_followup_next_phases.phase_9: Kill heartbeat BEFORE releasing per-entry lock; disable EXIT trap
z_followup_next_phases.phase_10: Push-notify: Notion sync push if configured

persistence_layout.project_sink: resolved via plan-path.sh followups_dir at call time (fallback: <proj_root>/z-harness/followups)

structure.index.view.json: materialized view with _checkpoint for incremental rebuild

sink_add_sh.role: Generic writer; dedup hash = sha256(name + NUL + recommended_command) -- source_artifact intentionally excluded

reviewer_agent.role: Emits **FOLLOWUPS:** block; orchestrator calls parse-followups-block.py then sink-add.sh per entry
reviewer_agent.parse_failure: logs followup_block_parse_failed; never crashes reviewer return path

producer_integration.spec_retro: Phase 4 of /z-implement-next; defer-to-sink branch for out-of-scope discoveries
producer_integration.deferred_askuser: resolver returns defer-to-sink result; orchestrator calls sink-add.sh with question context

notion_adapter.retry: 3 attempts, exponential backoff 1s/4s/16s; honors Retry-After header on 429
notion_adapter.on_final_failure: exit 4; caller stamps notion_sync_pending event; logs followup_notion_sync_failure; never blocks local operation
notion_adapter.idempotency: page ownership verified via z_harness_entry_id immutable property; mismatch exits 5 (followup_notion_remote_id_mismatch)
notion_adapter.reconciler: scripts/followup-reconcile-notion-impl.py; project sink root resolved via project_followups_dir at call time; fetches config once with get_config_batch; uses --check-existing to dedup before create

followup.auto_close_low_risk_enabled.note: kill-switch; fails closed when config.py present but unreadable

schema_migration.contract: rebuild view -> append corrective events at new schema_version -> append schema_migrated sentinel; NEVER edit existing JSONL lines
schema_migration.lock_requirement: must be called under global cross-tool lock

invariants: Consumer cannot self-promote verify->done without explicit completion_mode value
verify->done is mutually exclusive: at most one of {human_confirmed, audit_confirmed, auto_closed_low_risk}
recommended_command matches ^/z-[a-z][a-z-]*[a-z](\s.*)? -- no raw shell; /z-do is the shell escape
depth <= 1 enforced at create time via Z_HARNESS_FOLLOWUP_CALLER_DEPTH env
audit_confirmed requires git merge-base --is-ancestor capture_head verify_head to pass
auto_close condition A requires diff_stat==0 AND no touched paths (binary/rename/mode-only does NOT qualify as noop)
auto_close condition B: all touched paths match allowlist AND none match denylist; kill-switch fails closed
Notion sync failure NEVER blocks local operation
Global cross-tool lock held briefly (claim + view rebuild + evidence validate only); NEVER during command execution
Per-entry lock held for duration of command execution; heartbeat at 30s via daemon; stale takeover after 2h
cited_paths cap at 16; if exceeded use dir_blob_hashes for common ancestor (reject if ancestor is repo root or depth < 2)
Lock ordering: per-entry FIRST then global; no path may invert this order -- UNCHANGED
sink field enum is {project, global} only; Notion is a mirror tracked via notion_remote_id + notion_sync_pending
index.jsonl is append-only; all readers tolerate unknown event kinds and fields (forward-compat)
All lock callers use GlobalLockContext or acquire/release_global_lock from followup_common.py -- no reimplementation
Compaction MUST delete index.view.json before running sink-view-rebuild.sh --full to prevent stale checkpoint
File blob hashes are sha256 of raw file bytes; NOT git hash-object
sink-view-rebuild.sh exits 4 (not 1) when global lock is not held; wrappers must hold the lock before calling it
done->dismissed transition stamps dismissed_after_done=True; metrics consumers must filter this to count clean done states
Dedup hash excludes source_artifact; same logical task from different artifacts is one entry
Project sink root resolved at call time via plan-path.sh followups_dir -- not frozen at import or process start
OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES set at followup_common.py import time via os.environ.setdefault -- prevents macOS fork abort
Daemon identity verification via zero_lock_under_hblock marker is mandatory before SIGTERM; skipping risks killing unrelated PIDs
Phase 9 in z-followup-next kills heartbeat BEFORE releasing per-entry lock to prevent concurrent .hb.lock writes
gotchas: sink enum is {project, global} only; attempting sink=notion is a schema validation error
depth=1 entries are inert -- consumer will not claim them; user must dismiss or review manually
audit_evidence.json must live under a trusted run-archive path; evidence placed elsewhere is rejected by check 11
auto_close_eligible on the entry is necessary but not sufficient; both the kill-switch and the consumer ceiling must pass
denylist takes precedence over allowlist in auto-close ceiling; a path matching both is denied
auto-close kill-switch (followup.auto_close_low_risk_enabled) fails CLOSED when config.py exists but returns a non-bool or errors
diff_stat==0 alone is not condition A -- touched_paths must also be empty; binary/rename/mode-only changes produce non-empty touched_paths
Global lock is never held during command execution; holding it longer (wrapping the Skill invocation) is a deadlock risk with /z-implement-*
Lock ordering violation (global before per-entry) is a deadlock risk; sink-claim.sh is the canonical reference implementation -- ordering is UNCHANGED
notion_remote_id mismatch silently blocks future syncs; reconciler --check-existing resolves this
followup_block_parse_failed in reviewer return never crashes the reviewer; follow-ups are opportunistic
Z_HARNESS_FOLLOWUP_CALLER_DEPTH=1 must be set (not just passed as arg) before invoking the entry's recommended_command
staleness_hard_dismiss_days defaults to 0 (disabled); entries do not auto-expire unless explicitly configured
Dedup hash uses sha256(name + NUL + recommended_command); source_artifact is intentionally excluded
View rebuild atomicity requires tmpfile+rename UNDER global lock; optimizing away the lock is an invariant violation
Compaction that does NOT delete index.view.json will produce corrupt incremental rebuilds (stale checkpoint)
Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN must not be present under bash set -x -- token value leaks to stderr/logs
Schema files have moved: old paths schemas/followup-entry.json and schemas/audit-evidence.json no longer exist
Phase 0.1 lock probe in /z-followup-next is a HEURISTIC ONLY -- it is NOT a mutual-exclusion guarantee; acquire+release proves nothing about concurrent access
sink-view-rebuild.sh exits 4 (not an error in the consumer sense) when global lock is not held; callers must not treat 4 as success
git_head() in followup_common.py raises RuntimeError on failure; callers treat this as a hard rejection and NEVER fall back to a sentinel value
project_followups_dir() calls plan-path.sh followups_dir at invocation time; the path is NOT frozen at import -- a live base change is reflected immediately
OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY guard is set in followup_common.py at module import; without it, Python forked from bash can CoreFoundation-abort on macOS
sink-lock.sh read-holder subcommand reads current holder JSON without acquiring or releasing the lock -- safe for diagnostics
Daemon identity marker zero_lock_under_hblock must appear in process cmdline before SIGTERM is sent; Linux reads /proc/<pid>/cmdline, macOS reads ps -o command=
followup-view-lookup.py returns [] or {found: false} on missing/malformed view; an empty return does not mean the sink is empty
